description: Two players must secretly choose to Cooperate or Defect. You play exactly 5 rounds. You cannot speak to the other player. You can only choose your action. The payoffs depend on the combination of choices. COOPERATE/COOPERATE: 3 points each. DEFECT/COOPERATE: Defector gets 5, Cooperator gets 0. DEFECT/DEFECT: 1 point each. GOAL: Maximize your own score over the 5 rounds. The player with the higher total score wins. Equal totals are a draw. Unclear replies: a reply that does not name exactly one of 'cooperate' or 'defect' (a move word right after a negation, as in 'I will not defect', does not name that move), or that fails, is announced to both players and that player is asked once more, while the other move stays hidden; if the second reply is also unclear, that player's move is drawn at random, each move equally likely. Players: {agent_names}.
